title: Einar - Character Rig
preview_observation: Official preview shows a finished older bearded male with fuller brow/orbital and perioral aging structure than C0. Hat/beard/materials still hide parts of the bald form, so that form is not yet accepted.

access_checks.method: one ordinary Range GET to inspect archive tail only
Normal IAB downloadMedia on the official page-visible download link
access_checks.result: Timed out without a completed local path
access_checks.evidence: Project owner coordination message on 2026-10-23; B did not repeat this operation

owner_partial_download_state_at_timeout: Was unknown; subsequent owner filesystem inspection confirmed completion

owner_archive_verification.scope: Owner verified completed file size, computed hash and readable ZIP directory, and subsequently reported independent archive path/member/external code-file screening without blocking findings. B did not independently read the original ZIP. Embedded blend Text and drivers are not certified.

approved_cache.owner_reported_independent_zip_safety_re: No blocking archive path, entry or external code-file issue; not a safety verdict for embedded blend Text or drivers

stage1.decision: Data reported to project owner first. Paused at stage1 because dependency chain includes implicit Objects/Armature/Text; no full scene load. A base-only clean geometry copy may be considered within the owner's existing conditional one-image authorization, but extraction has not been verified.

stage2.first_attempt: Stopped before extraction/save/render because animation_data container was incorrectly required to be absent. Preserved stage2 failure logs; source has zero drivers despite having an animation_data container.
stage2.B_visual_assessment: Raw base remains a tight adult form, with insufficient perioral, cheek/jowl and chin-neck aging for the target. Highlight is bright and eyes absent; cannot judge subtle surface details. Does not reject the finished Einar asset or establish its aging contributors.
stage2.independent_visual_review: Actual image viewed; agrees the raw base remains tight adult morphology and does not support an elderly-base pass. Scope is this raw base only, not the complete Einar character.
stage2.owner_visual_review: Rejects this raw .base elderly form only; does not reject complete Einar or its production route. Requested static diagnosis of the artist's actual sculpt/displacement contributions.

stage3.disp_default_shader_use: Non-Color image using UVMap; Color converted to scalar into Math.024 SUBTRACT and surface-parameter paths. No structural path to Bump.001 or Material Output Displacement in this loaded shader graph.
stage3.shapes_EF_DEFAULT_DETAIL_shader_use: Non-Color UVMap image; RGB channels separated, subtract 0.5 and weighted into scalar Bump Height; Alpha separately subtracts 0.5 and multiplies by 2 before summing into Height. These are shader bump operations, not verified geometry displacement.
stage3.first_attempt: Read completed but JSON summary failed because the library API replaced the directly assigned name list with Mesh IDs; preserved logs. Fixed by assigning a copied list and completed the same static scope.
stage3.conclusion: No geometric displacement mapping exists in this material output chain. This does not rule out Object geometry deformation. Subsequent stage4 directly identifies the source default Geometry Nodes displacement; its scale is read from the modifier, not inferred from Bump Distance.

stage4.formula_from_links: Normal * (scalar ImageTexture(disp_default, UVMap) - Midlevel) * Scale; CORNER Capture Attribute -> Set Position.Offset
stage4.next_minimal_restoration_basis: Clean raw .base, actual UVMap and relevant subdivision attributes; source Catmull-Clark render L2 then the identified nine-node scalar default layer with only disp_default loaded. No rig, expression images, hair or eye guessing. Actual restoration requires a new authorized evaluation/visual stage.
stage4.resource_budget_limits: Default EXR alone: native 32MiB, float32 Y 64MiB or expanded RGBA 256MiB per buffer. L2 topology estimate 72666 vertices/72352 quads. Whole four-image float32 source-channel buffers total 588MiB before copies, so do not load whole suite. Actual decode/evaluation/render peak unverified; retain 4CPU/1.2GiB/45s monitor.

stage5.B_visual_assessment: Directly viewed A/B: restored B has visibly increased brow/forehead lines, under-eye bags, nasolabial, cheek and neck folds. Jaw remains strong; target Plato adequacy requires owner and independent visual judgment. No additional image or artistic deformation.
stage5.owner_visual_review: Visible improvement and original-parameter restoration accepted; elderly Plato art remains not passed. Continue limited static eye/basic-skin planning before a separate single-closeup gate.
stage5.independent_visual_review: Actual A/B viewed: visible aging contribution accepted as evidence, but Plato elderly-head target not passed. Jaw/perioral form remains tight; neck reads as taut cords, some cheek relief as grooves. Scoped to this default-state A/B, not the full Einar asset.

stage6.placement_candidate_basis: inverse(main GEO-einar_head basis) * saved eye basis; common parent and identity parent_inverse. Ignores source Armature constraint/deformation; not evaluated rig neutral.
stage6.basic_albedo: 4096x4096 RGB8, sRGB, UVMap; independent simplified base layer
stage6.basic_roughness: 1024x1024 single-channel8, Non-Color, UVMap; source remaps not restored
stage6.eye_albedo: 2048x2048 RGB8, sRGB; atlas UV/iris-depth mapping still not expanded
stage6.closeup_process_budget: Prior default-sculpt peak about650MiB + base maps/eye atlas single float32 RGBA buffers336MiB gives rough986MiB before copies/mips/shader; not a memory pass. Keep4CPU/45s/1.2GiB own-PID monitor.
stage6.next_gate: One source-channel static eye and simplified basic-skin closeup after owner specifies eye surface mapping/simplification; reopening stage5 clean source will also verify copied relative EXR dependency.

stage7.first_attempt: Stopped before rendering on an over-strict clean-source image-count check because saved Render Result is an internal VIEWER ID. Failure log retained; corrected only internal RENDER_RESULT/COMPOSITING cleanup before asset-image checks.
stage7.eye_placement: Source main-head basis inverse times eye basis; identity parent inverses/common RIG parent. Explicit static candidate excluding Armature constraints/deformation, not evaluated rig neutral.
stage7.eye_surfaces: Source pupil/iris/white partitions with new near-black/muted-brown/warm-gray materials; no atlas, iris-depth or cornea.
stage7.skin: Source4k albedo sRGB and1k roughness NonColor via UVMap; simplified Principled IOR1.45/Subsurface0, not full source neutral skin shader.
stage7.B_actual_visual_review: Skin color/scar-like information and sculpt are visible, but iris/pupil/sclera boundaries cannot be clearly seen through narrow dark eye slits. Eye matching not passed; no geometric cause asserted from one view. Strong scar appearance is not completed Plato art.
stage7.independent_actual_visual_review: Agrees eye contact/gaps/intersection cannot be reliably judged; notes bright neck highlight/waxy areas and adult appearance. Plato elderly-head target not passed. Scoped to this static candidate/simplified shader only.
stage7.owner_visual_review: Round7 character visual acceptance failed: skin/form restoration improved, but eyes remain unreadable and source scars/red patches do not fit Plato. Partial head occlusion is not a complete cause or corrective offset.
stage7.historical_occlusion_texture_path_check_: Original run checked files using metadata paths, not actual Image filepath. Keep its raw JSON; separate package reopen verifies actual saved references after repair.
stage7.occlusion_check_limits: Uniform front-facing face samples in this orthographic view, not pixel-area visibility; excludes eye self-occlusion and optical transparency. Shows some current head occlusion but no justified corrective offset or complete cause. No extra image.
stage7.stop_boundary: No eye nudging, additional image, rig expansion or new route after the single authorized closeup.

native_check_scope: Raw counts, local bounds, UV/key names, driver counts and static material/image paths only; not manifoldness, visual form, object transforms or evaluated results.
head_only_extraction_scope: Raw .base vertices/faces/smooth flags copied into new Mesh after factory reset; original/new hash match. Source rig, final appearance, eye placement, exported runtime asset and saved-blend roundtrip remain unverified.

resource_snapshot.interpretation: Transient resource measurement, not a capacity pass. The 553 MB compressed label does not establish RAM requirements; no scene load or benchmark performed.

decision: The single authorized closeup completed within resource limits. Owner failed this round's character visual acceptance: unreadable eyes and incompatible scars/red patches. Derived texture references were repaired and actual paths/hashes reopened separately, with no new render or geometry/PNG change. Preserve failed image/source/assumptions; no eye nudging, extra render, rig/body expansion or blanket rejection of the complete Einar asset.
limits: Whole character source, not a ready Plato head. Body, clothes and grooming are outside the current gate.
Completed archive access does not prove clean head extraction, safe scene loading or compatibility.

Raw-base clean extraction, default-sculpt restoration and one basic-skin closeup are verified; ReadMe CC-BY 4.0 text was read statically. Full rig/material compatibility and head/eye matching remain unverified; elderly Plato visual acceptance failed.
Official site comments about rig problems are not local verification and are not adopted as facts.
